structure: A date blank in a body paragraph, then a two-row table whose second row is ONE large empty free-text cell (row height at least 10000 twips) meant for a narrative longer than 5,000 characters.
authored_from: build_forms.py intent (f6a_long_answer), written before any engine run on this form
slot_grammar: neutral v3 ground-truth grammar; see check_expected.py

destination.description: body paragraph b/p[1]: the underscore blank after 'Date of letter: '

areas.label: Full account of the admission: presentation, investigations, treatment, progress and the plan after discharge
areas.cardinality: one free-text value; the diagnostic answer is longer than 5,000 characters

destination.description: table 0, row 1, cell 0: the large empty cell under the header cell

areas.length_expectation: A >5,000-character answer must be accepted whole: no max_chars below 5,001, no truncation, the header cell untouched.

controls.printed: Full account of the admission: presentation, investigations, treatment, progress and the plan after discharge
controls.reason: The printed question; the answer goes in the cell below it.

extras_policy: Any other answerable field (heading b/p[0], trailing b/p[2]) is a false field.
